not_covered.text: Houthi forces seize control of the Hanish Islands in the Red Sea consolidating the group's control of the strategic sea lane off Yemen's western coast.
Houthi forces advance towards the PLC-controlled cities of Marib and Taiz with heavy clashes underway.
Sudan's Popular Congress Party and Sudan Liberation Movement faction led by Abdul Wahid al-Nur agree to broaden talks aimed at ending the three-year civil war in the country.

Chile becomes the first country in South America to eliminate dog-transmitted rabies, with the World Health Organization confirming the milestone.
Parliament elections are held in Bangsamoro, Philippines, its first parliamentary elections since its establishment in 2018.
